subject: Realtime feature handshake & acceptance criteria
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@healthgauge.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Kickoff: realtime streaming + tool-calls (HealthGauge)

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — great to see Redwood's streaming and function/tool-calling features in action. HealthGauge is prioritizing two flows for launch: (1) live triage streaming (short user utterances, sub-200 token responses) and (2) structured referrals output (JSON payload with specific keys that our downstream accepts).

We attached a short requirements doc (HealthGauge_reqs_v1.pdf) that has the sample payloads and the list of fields the downstream systems expect. The ask for this thread: confirm a minimal acceptance criteria list we can sign off on and a sprint start date.

Target: pilot in sandbox within two weeks, production in four weeks (subject to acceptance).

Initial integration contacts: Alyssa Chen (me) and dev@healthgauge.com.

Alyssa Chen
Head of Integrations, HealthGauge
[Attachment: HealthGauge_reqs_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@healthgauge.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: realtime streaming + tool-calls (HealthGauge)

Thanks Alyssa — excited to get started. I pulled the key items from your requirements doc and drafted a concise runtime acceptance contract attached (runtime-acceptance-criteria.md). High level summary below and action items for the next 48 hours.

Summary (short):
- Streaming: end-to-end RTT <= 400ms p95 for 256-token sequences; continuous prefix caching enabled; graceful degradation to 2-token batching when under heavy tail.
- Function/Tool calls: Signed schema contract — Redwood will emit a top-level "tool_call" object with "name", "args" and "confidence". Must validate against HealthGauge's structured-referral schema.
- Structured outputs: JSON-only mode for production flows; schema validation on Redwood side with failure modes surfaced in the response (error_reason field).

Immediate action items:
1) HealthGauge: confirm the exact JSON keys and an authoritative sample payload to be used as the schema ground truth (reply with sample_payload.json).
2) Redwood (Rishi): estimate dev-time for schema validation + canary route and confirm whether any model variant will change the output shape.
3) CS (Monica/Tessa): schedule a 30-minute kick-off call for Tuesday to align roles.

Proposed sprint start: 2026-11-09 (two business days to confirm sample payload + calendar). If we get the sample by EOD 11/05 we can hit the sandbox pilot target 11/23.

I've attached the runtime acceptance criteria doc for signing.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: runtime-acceptance-criteria.md (md)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa@healthgauge.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: realtime streaming + tool-calls (HealthGauge)

Kimberly — quick technical notes from infra/serving runtime perspective. 

On the schema and streaming constraints:
- Schema validation: we can plug HealthGauge's canonical JSON schema (Draft-07) into our pre-response hook. Validation will run in a sandbox path. If the output fails, Redwood will return a structured failure with the following shape: {"status":"schema_failure","errors": [ ... ], "raw_output": "..."}. We will not drop tokens; errors are surfaced.
- Streaming: we recommend enabling prefix KV caching for repeated utterances in the triage flow — with your expected usage distribution this will reduce per-token cost ~20% without negative impact on latency.
- Canary plan: build a canary route that points 5% of traffic to the new JSON-only transformer; rollback trigger: any schema failure >1% or p95 latency spike >+25% vs baseline.

Potential blockers to call out:
- If HealthGauge requires schema transformation (field renames / flattening) we should add a lightweight mapping step in the tool-call stage — that is a small team task but needs explicit examples.
- For function/tool calls: we must agree on the tool vocabulary upfront (names + arg types). Open to a short doc from HealthGauge listing tool names used by downstream (e.g., "create_referral", "route_to_clinician").

Estimate: schema validation + canary hook + basic mapping layer = 3 engineering days (Rishi + 1). Streaming tuning and observability dashboards = 2 days.

I'll add these items to the sprint plan once we get sample_payload.json.

—Rishi
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@healthgauge.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-06T09:38:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: realtime streaming + tool-calls (HealthGauge)

Alyssa / team — looping in the CS onboarding checklist and a one-page sprint plan. I attached a compact onboarding-sprint-plan.xlsx with responsibilities, milestones, and acceptance checkpoints. 

Playbook highlights:
- Week 0 (pre-sprint): confirm sample payload + access to sandbox, share test dataset (anonymized).
- Week 1: implement schema validation + tool vocabulary mapping, create canary route and run smoke tests.
- Week 2: run contract acceptance tests, fix any schema edge cases, enable structured-output for production path behind feature flag.

Deliverables and owners:
- Sample payload validation and signed acceptance criteria: HealthGauge (Alyssa) + Redwood (Kimberly/Rishi)
- Canary monitoring: Rishi (engineering) + Monica (CS) set alert thresholds
- Production cutover checklist: Tessa (ops)

Suggested kickoff: Tuesday 2026-11-09 11:00 AM PT — 30 minutes. Calendar invite will go out once Alyssa confirms the sample payload.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: onboarding-sprint-plan.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@healthgauge.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: dev@healthgauge.com
Date: 2026-11-09T16:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: realtime streaming + tool-calls (HealthGauge)

Thanks everyone — confirm we accept the proposed acceptance criteria and the canary thresholds. Attached is the authoritative sample payload (sample_payload.json) and a short mapping table for two fields that need to be renamed on Redwood's side (patientId -> patient_id, triageLevel -> urgency_level).

We can do the 11/09 11:00 AM PT kickoff; the dev team (dev@healthgauge.com) will join. Looking forward to the sprint.

Best,
Alyssa
Head of Integrations, HealthGauge
[Attachment: sample_payload.json (json)]
